sampling_band.note: Shadow reading from server recounts (or the backfilled dispersion shadow); stored labels and counters are untouched. all_unconfirmable means every eligible disagreement on this original lies inside the sampling band: a same-design rerun of similar dispersion is likely to land there too. It is a reading of the existing samples, not an impossibility: the band never touches the point-rule agreement set, so a fresh replication can still file a point agreement.
